title: relay queue decisions: a list of every decision
what: A view in lib/queue_ext/ listing question notes with decided_by or an owner answer, newest first: date, who decided, the choice, standing/overruled/confirmed from answer_choice, item, title; --by and --days filters (default 14, bound 1-90). Design: Part 2 of the agent-answered-decisions design (queue item a-queue-question-can-be-answered-by-an-agent-mar).
why: Step 1 of the agent-answered decisions records them per item; finding them across items still means asking the front.
